title: Illustrative OAuth and OIDC authorization lifecycle
description: Illustrative authorization-code flow with OIDC identity data, access tokens, trust boundaries and failures. It is provider-neutral, contains no live credentials or token values, and does not describe a deployed identity system.

metadata.evidence: Declared protocol walkthrough; not observed traffic or a security assessment.

nodes.label: User device and browser
nodes.description: The user-agent boundary where redirects and consent screens are visible.

evidence.source: Illustrative trust boundary; no browser session is observed.

nodes.label: End user
nodes.description: The person requesting access to the client application.

evidence.source: Illustrative actor; no identity or credential is represented.

nodes.label: Browser user agent
nodes.description: Carries front-channel redirects and the authorization code.

evidence.source: Illustrative protocol participant.

nodes.label: Relying-party application
nodes.description: The OAuth client that requests tokens and calls the protected API.

evidence.source: Illustrative application trust boundary; no client registration is live.

nodes.label: Web client application
nodes.description: Uses a configured client identifier and PKCE; no client secret or token value is included.

evidence.source: Illustrative OAuth client behavior.

nodes.label: Redirect callback
nodes.description: Receives the authorization code and returns it to the back channel.

evidence.source: Illustrative redirect URI endpoint; no live URL is configured.

nodes.label: Authorization server trust boundary
nodes.description: Authenticates the user, grants authorization and signs tokens.

evidence.source: Illustrative authorization-server boundary; provider-neutral by design.

nodes.label: Authorization server
nodes.description: Authenticates the user, records consent and issues an authorization code.

evidence.source: Illustrative OAuth/OIDC role; no provider affiliation is implied.

nodes.label: Identity and consent store
nodes.description: Stores illustrative user and consent state behind the authorization server.

evidence.source: Proposed logical store for the illustrative flow; no personal data is present.

nodes.label: Token endpoint
nodes.description: Exchanges a code or refresh token for signed token responses.

evidence.source: Illustrative OAuth token endpoint role.

nodes.label: JWKS signing-key endpoint
nodes.description: Publishes public signing keys used to validate token signatures.

evidence.source: Illustrative OIDC key-discovery role; no key material is embedded.

nodes.label: Protected API trust boundary
nodes.description: Validates bearer tokens before serving protected resource data.

evidence.source: Illustrative resource-server boundary; no API is reachable.

nodes.label: Resource server API
nodes.description: Protects an API and accepts access tokens with the required scope.

evidence.source: Illustrative OAuth resource-server role.

nodes.label: Token validation policy
nodes.description: Checks signature, issuer, audience, expiry and scope before access.

evidence.source: Inferred validation responsibilities from the illustrative protocol flow.

nodes.label: Protected resource data
nodes.description: Generic application data returned only after authorization checks.

evidence.source: Proposed resource representation; no live data is included.
